text:
infra-bot: Heads up — planned maintenance proposal for US-WEST1 cache nodes. Kernel + NVMe firmware update. Original window Thu 02:00-03:00 UTC; ops recommends shifting to WED 23:00-23:30 UTC to avoid customer peak. Expected: rolling restarts across AZs, brief cache warmup; risk: transient 5xx for in-flight requests if fallback misses. No DB changes. Asking SRE + oncall + comms to review and prepare status/customer comms. :rotating_light:

maria: I can own the runbook and be lead during the window. Will run in staged AZ order (a->b->c) and validate KV hit-rate / latency after each AZ. I'll post step-by-step once we lock the time.

alex: oncall ack — I can take primary for the window. I'll do handoff at 22:45 UTC and stay until 00:15 UTC. Paging: if error rate over baseline +0.5% for >5m, page pager-duty-escalate.

elaine: Comms ack. Drafting status page + customer notification now. Drafts below — please react with edits.

elaine: STATUS PAGE DRAFT (short):
```
Scheduled maintenance: US-WEST1 cache layer — Wed 23:00–23:30 UTC
We will perform a rolling firmware and kernel update on cache nodes in us-west1. You may see brief transient errors (5xx) or increased latencies for up to a few minutes during rolling restarts. No data loss expected. We will update this page if anything changes.
```

elaine: CUSTOMER EMAIL / PORTAL NOTICE DRAFT (short):
```
Subject: Brief maintenance in us-west1 — Wed 23:00 UTC
We will perform a short maintenance to update firmware on our cache nodes in us-west1. During the maintenance (approx. 23:00–23:30 UTC) you may experience brief interruptions or slightly elevated latencies. There will be no data loss. If you rely on very strict latency SLAs during that window, reply and we will offer temporary dedicated capacity options.
```

elaine: Will post status page update ~15m before window and switch to "maintenance in progress" at start. 

sam: Support templates queued. Q/A for CS:
- Q: Will my jobs fail? A: Most requests will succeed; some may experience retries. When in doubt, check status.redwood.ai for live updates.
- Q: Can you avoid my customers? A: For Dedicated customers we can coordinate a narrower window — tag me and tony.

maria: Runbook (brief):
1) pre-check: confirm canary traffic < 1% and backups OK
2) cordon node and drain cache instance in AZ-a
3) apply firmware + reboot
4) smoke test: 50 requests @prod seq len 256, check 5xx and p95 latency
5) if smoke ok -> proceed to AZ-b after 3m stabilization
6) if smoke fail -> abort to rollback image and notify oncall + comms

maria: I'll paste logs and metrics channel links during ops. Also will set temporary routing to fallback model variants if cache miss rate spikes.

tony: Product ops — we'll prepare a short note for Dedicated customers. If anyone flagged for SLA-level mitigation, please DM me prior to 21:00 UTC. We can enable reserved capacity for critical tenants.

status-bot: STATUSPAGE: updated to "Scheduled Maintenance" for US-WEST1 cache. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/maintenance-uw1-1769998888

elaine: Quick note: curl snippet to push status update (for ops):
```
curl -X POST https://status.redwood.ai/api/v1/incidents \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${STATUS_API_TOKEN}' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"component": "us-west1-cache", "status": "maintenance", "body": "Planned firmware update — short rolling restarts"}'
```

alex: oncall handoff plan: I will be primary; maria is secondary. Pager channel: #pager-duty-escalate and call tree if >15m outage. Hand-off note to night oncall (Jae): see pinned runbook in #eng-oncall.

elaine: final ask — react with :+1: if copy good, or post edits. I'll post the public notice 15m before start.

alex: :+1:

maria: :+1:

tony: :+1:

sam: :+1:

---

[POST-MAINTENANCE] infra-bot: Maintenance complete — all cache nodes back online. Observed a short spike in 5xxs (~0.15% above baseline) for ~4 minutes during AZ-b reboot; back to baseline after warmup. No customer data impact. Closing maintenance flag.

elaine: Published final status update: "Completed — brief impact observed, monitoring." Copy pushed to customers who replied.

sam: Support: logged 3 tickets flagged as "impact observed" — CS handled; customers informed and offered mitigation options.

maria: Ops notes: we rolled back one aborted patch attempt in AZ-c and re-ran with corrected firmware image; details to be in postmortem. Will file runbook improvements.

alex: Handoff back to day oncall at 00:20 UTC. No open pages. :white_check_mark:

status-bot: Status page updated to "Operational" for us-west1-cache. Incident closed: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/maintenance-uw1-1769998888

elaine: Thanks all. I'll post email summary and the customer list we notified in #customer-notify thread. Closing this announcement thread. :wave:
